lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: The branch is closed. If this is about an account, it will have to wait until morning.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: It’s not about an account.

lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: Then I am at a loss. Most people only seek me out for professional reasons.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I saw you looking at a deck list earlier.

lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: ...You are observant. That is either useful or inconvenient.

lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: Very well. You have five minutes. Use them carefully.

choices.label: Ask about her preferred strategy
choices.reply: Control. Always control. I dislike leaving outcomes to chance.

choices.label: Comment on how composed she stays even off the clock
choices.reply: Composure is not a switch I turn off. It is simply how I move through the world.

choices.label: Hold her gaze a moment longer than necessary
choices.reply: You have unusual eyes for someone making idle conversation. Do not make a habit of it.

lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: I adjusted my evening review to include this. Do not make me regret the exception.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You actually cleared time?

lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: I clear time for things I have judged worth the cost. The judgment is still under evaluation.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Harsh.

lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: Accurate. I prefer accuracy to comfort.

lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: You may sit. The light is better on this side of the table.

choices.label: Discuss a specific control line with her
choices.reply: You prepared. I appreciate people who do not waste the time I allocate.

choices.label: Ask what she does when plans fail
choices.reply: I revise. Quickly. And I do not announce the revision until it is complete.

choices.label: Tell her the exception feels significant
choices.reply: Do not inflate it. And do not look at me like that while saying it.

openingByFlag.elena_strategy: You asked about strategy. I have continued that evaluation.
openingByFlag.elena_composed: You commented on my composure. It remains intact. For now.
openingByFlag.elena_gaze: You held my gaze longer than necessary last time. I have not forgotten.

lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: I left the blazer at the office. Do not read anything into it.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: It looks different.

lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: Everything looks different when the structure is removed. That is why I prefer the structure.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: And yet you’re here without it.

lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: A temporary variance. I will correct it tomorrow.

lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: You are looking at my mouth. Is there a reason?

choices.label: Say you were just listening carefully
choices.reply: Then continue. I am still deciding whether this conversation is efficient.

choices.label: Admit the softer look suits her
choices.reply: Softer is not a word I encourage. But I will allow the observation this once.

choices.label: Hold her eyes and tell her the control is part of the appeal
choices.reply: You are playing a dangerous game with someone who calculates risk for a living.

openingByFlag.elena_prepared: You arrived prepared last time. I adjusted my own preparations accordingly.
openingByFlag.elena_revise: You asked what I do when plans fail. Today’s plan has already required a minor revision.
openingByFlag.elena_significant: You called the exception significant. I am still weighing that assessment.

lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: This was not on my calendar. I am aware of the irony.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You came anyway.

lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: Yes. I am still examining why.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Maybe you wanted to.

lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: Want is an imprecise variable. I prefer clearer metrics.

lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: And yet here I am, walking without a destination and allowing the conversation to drift. This is unlike me.

choices.label: Tell her you like this version of her
choices.reply: Then you are accepting a version I do not fully understand yet. That is a risk.

choices.label: Ask if the loss of control is as frightening as she expected
choices.reply: It is quieter than I anticipated. That may be the more dangerous part.

choices.label: Close the distance slightly and wait
choices.reply: You are testing the boundary. I have not moved away. Take that as the data it is.

openingByFlag.elena_listen: You listened carefully last time. I am still speaking.
openingByFlag.elena_softer: You said softer suited me. I have not corrected the record.
openingByFlag.elena_risk: You called the control part of the appeal. I am still calculating the exposure.

lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: I have reviewed the last several weeks. The deviations from my usual pattern are significant.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: And the conclusion?

lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: That I have allowed one person more access than is strictly efficient. And that I do not wish to revoke it.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: That’s a big statement coming from you.

lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: I do not make small statements when the data is clear.

lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: So. Are you prepared to remain a variable I no longer try to eliminate?

choices.label: Tell her you’re staying
choices.reply: Then the ledger is updated. Do not make me revise it again without cause.

choices.label: Kiss her carefully and let the answer be physical
choices.reply: ...That was not a scheduled action. I will allow it.

choices.label: Say you want both the controlled version and the one that slips
choices.reply: Both. You continue to request both. Very well. I will attempt to provide them.

openingByFlag.elena_version: You said you liked this version. I have continued to allow it.
openingByFlag.elena_quiet: You asked about the quiet loss of control. It has not become louder.
openingByFlag.elena_boundary: You tested the boundary. I am still standing on the same side of it.
